{sp:16}WELCOME TO ADVENTURE!!

{sp:6}Original development by {^}W{/^}illie {^}C{/^}rowther
{sp:9}Major features added by {^}D{/^}on {^}W{/^}oods.
{sp:13}This port by {^}O{/^}li {^}H{/^}owson.

Would you like instructions?
Please answer the question.  Would you like instructions?
I don't know that word.
Sorry but I am not allowed to give more detail.

Somewhere nearby is {^}C{/^}olossal Cave, where others have found fortunes in treasure and gold, though it is rumoured that some who enter are never seen again. Magic is said to work in the cave. I will be your eyes and hands. Direct me with commands of 1 or 2 words.
Should you get stuck, type "HELP" for some hints. FOR INFORMATION ON HOW TO END YOUR ADVENTURE, ETC., TYPE "INFO".)
{sp:16}- - -
THIS PROGRAM WAS ORIGINALLY DEVELOPED BY {^}W{/^}illie {^}C{/^}rowther}.  MOST OF THE FEATURES OF THE CURRENT PROGRAM WERE ADDED BY {^}D{/^}on {^}W{/^}oods. This port was developed by {^}O{/^}li {^}H{/^}owson (Oli.Howson@open.ac.uk) CONTACT {^}Oli{/^} IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS, COMMENTS, ETC.
YOU FELL INTO A PIT AND BROKE EVERY BONE IN YOUR BODY!
YOUR LAMP HAS RUN OUT OF POWER.
YOUR LAMP IS GETTING DIM.  YOU'D BEST START WRAPPING THIS UP, UNLESS YOU CAN FIND SOME FRESH BATTERIES.  I SEEM TO RECALL THERE'S A VENDING MACHINE IN THE MAZE.  BRING SOME COINS WITH YOU.
YOUR LAMP IS GETTING DIM.  YOU'D BEST GO BACK FOR THOSE BATTERIES.
YOUR LAMP IS GETTING DIM.  I'M TAKING THE LIBERTY OF REPLACING THE BATTERIES
YOUR LAMP IS GETTING DIM, AND YOU'RE OUT OF SPARE BATTERIES.  YOU'D BEST START WRAPPING THIS UP.
THE GRATE IS NOW UNLOCKED.
IT WAS ALREADY UNLOCKED.
THE GRATE IS NOW LOCKED.
IT WAS ALREADY LOCKED.
YOU HAVE NO KEYS!
THE BIRD WAS UNAFRAID WHEN YOU ENTERED, BUT AS YOU APPROACH IT BECOMES DISTURBED AND YOU CANNOT CATCH IT.
YOU CAN CATCH THE BIRD, BUT YOU CANNOT CARRY IT.
THE LITTLE BIRD ATTACKS THE GREEN SNAKE, AND IN AN ASTOUNDING FLURRY DRIVES THE SNAKE AWAY.
You can't get by the snake.
THE LITTLE BIRD IS NOW DEAD.  ITS BODY DISAPPEARS.
ATTACKING THE SNAKE BOTH DOESN'T WORK AND IS VERY DANGEROUS.
THERE IS NOTHING HERE TO ATTACK.
IT'S NOT HUNGRY (IT'S MERELY PININ' FOR THE FJORDS).  BESIDES, YOU HAVE NO BIRD SEED.
THE SNAKE HAS NOW DEVOURED YOUR BIRD.
THE VASE IS NOW RESTING, DELICATELY, ON A VELVET PILLOW.
YOU HAVE TAKEN THE VASE AND HURLED IT DELICATELY TO THE GROUND.
THE MING VASE DROPS WITH A DELICATE CRASH.
YOUR BOTTLE IS NOW FULL OF OIL.
YOUR BOTTLE IS NOW FULL OF WATER.
THE DOOR IS EXTREMELY RUSTY AND REFUSES TO OPEN.
THE OIL HAS FREED UP THE HINGES SO THAT THE DOOR WILL NOW MOVE, ALTHOUGH IT REQUIRES SOME EFFORT.
YOUR BOTTLE IS ALREADY FULL.
YOUR BOTTLE IS EMPTY AND THE GROUND IS WET.
YOU CAN'T FILL THAT.
THERE IS NOTHING HERE WITH WHICH TO FILL THE BOTTLE.
YOU HAVE NOTHING IN WHICH TO CARRY IT.
A CRYSTAL BRIDGE NOW SPANS THE FISSURE.
THE CRYSTAL BRIDGE HAS VANISHED!
THERE IS NO WAY ACROSS THE FISSURE.
I RESPECTFULLY SUGGEST YOU GO ACROSS THE BRIDGE INSTEAD OF JUMPING.
{^}CONGRATULATIONS ON BRINGING LIGHT INTO THE DARK-ROOM!{/^}
YOU CAN'T FIT THIS FIVE-FOOT CLAM THROUGH THAT LITTLE PASSAGE!
I ADVISE YOU TO PUT DOWN THE CLAM BEFORE OPENING IT.  >STRAIN!<
YOU DON'T HAVE ANYTHING STRONG ENOUGH TO OPEN THE CLAM.

A GLISTENING PEARL FALLS OUT OF THE CLAM AND ROLLS AWAY.  GOODNESS, THIS MUST REALLY BE AN OYSTER. ({^}I{/^} NEVER WAS VERY GOOD AT IDENTIFYING BIVALVES.)  {^}W{/^}HATEVER IT IS, IT HAS NOW SNAPPED SHUT AGAIN.
YOU CAN'T FIT THIS FIVE-FOOT OYSTER THROUGH THAT LITTLE PASSAGE!
I ADVISE YOU TO PUT DOWN THE OYSTER BEFORE OPENING IT.	>WRENCH!<
YOU DON'T HAVE ANYTHING STRONG ENOUGH TO OPEN THE OYSTER.
THE OYSTER CREAKS OPEN, REVEALING NOTHING BUT OYSTER INSIDE.  IT PROMPTLY SNAPS SHUT AGAIN.
THE SHELL IS VERY STRONG AND IS IMPERVIOUS TO ATTACK.
I'M AFRAID THE MAGAZINE IS WRITTEN IN DWARVISH.
THANK YOU, IT WAS DELICIOUS!
THE BEAR EAGERLY WOLFS DOWN YOUR FOOD, AFTER WHICH HE SEEMS TO CALM DOWN CONSIDERABLY AND EVEN BECOMES RATHER FRIENDLY.
THERE'S NOTHING HERE IT WANTS TO EAT (EXCEPT PERHAPS YOU).
THE CHAIN IS NOW UNLOCKED.
THE CHAIN IS NOW LOCKED.
THERE IS NO WAY TO GET PAST THE BEAR TO UNLOCK THE CHAIN, WHICH IS PROBABLY JUST AS WELL.
THE CHAIN IS STILL LOCKED.
THE BEAR IS STILL CHAINED TO THE WALL.
THE BEAR LUMBERS TOWARD THE TROLL, WHO LETS OUT A STARTLED SHRIEK AND SCURRIES AWAY.  THE BEAR SOON GIVES UP THE PURSUIT AND WANDERS BACK.
TROLLS ARE CLOSE RELATIVES WITH THE ROCKS AND HAVE SKIN AS TOUGH AS THAT OF A RHINOCEROS.  THE TROLL FENDS OFF YOUR BLOWS EFFORTLESSLY.

JUST AS YOU REACH THE OTHER SIDE, THE BRIDGE BUCKLES BENEATH THE WEIGHT OF THE BEAR, WHICH WAS STILL FOLLOWING YOU AROUND.  YOU SCRABBLE DESPERATELY FOR SUPPORT,BUT AS THE BRIDGE COLLAPSES YOU STUMBLE BACK AND FALL INTO THE CHASM.
THERE IS NO LONGER ANY WAY ACROSS THE CHASM.
GLUTTONY IS NOT ONE OF THE TROLL'S VICES.  AVARICE, HOWEVER, IS.
THE TROLL REFUSES TO LET YOU CROSS.
THE TROLL CATCHES YOUR TREASURE AND SCURRIES AWAY OUT OF SIGHT.
THE TROLL STEPS OUT FROM BENEATH THE BRIDGE AND BLOCKS YOUR WAY.
THE TROLL DEFTLY CATCHES THE AXE, EXAMINES IT CAREFULLY, AND TOSSES IT BACK, DECLARING, "GOOD WORKMANSHIP, BUT IT'S NOT VALUABLE ENOUGH."
THE AXE MISSES AND LANDS NEAR THE BEAR WHERE YOU CAN'T GET AT IT.
WHAT'S THE MATTER, CAN'T YOU READ?  NOW YOU'D BEST START OVER.
GOOD TRY, BUT THAT IS AN OLD WORN-OUT MAGIC WORD.
THE NEST OF GOLDEN EGGS HAS VANISHED!
DONE!
THERE ARE FRESH BATTERIES HERE.
THE PLANT SPURTS INTO FURIOUS GROWTH FOR A FEW SECONDS.
THE PLANT GROWS EXPLOSIVELY, ALMOST FILLING THE BOTTOM OF THE PIT.
YOU'VE OVER-WATERED THE PLANT! IT'S SHRIVELING UP! IT'S, IT'S...
THE PLANT INDIGNANTLY SHAKES THE OIL OFF ITS LEAVES AND ASKS, `WATER?`
THE PLANT HAS EXCEPTIONALLY DEEP ROOTS AND CANNOT BE PULLED FREE.
IT IS TOO FAR UP FOR YOU TO REACH.
THE SHADOWY FIGURE SEEMS TO BE TRYING TO ATTRACT YOUR ATTENTION.
WITH WHAT?  YOUR BARE HANDS?  AGAINST *HIS* BEAR HANDS??
CONGRATULATIONS!  YOU HAVE JUST VANQUISHED A DRAGON WITH YOUR BARE HANDS!	(UNBELIEVABLE, ISN'T IT?)
THE DRAGON LOOKS RATHER NASTY.  YOU'D BEST NOT TRY TO GET BY.
FOR CRYING OUT LOUD, THE POOR THING IS ALREADY DEAD.
THERE'S NOTHING HERE IT WANTS TO EAT (EXCEPT PERHAPS YOU).
THE LITTLE BIRD ATTACKS THE GREEN DRAGON, AND IN AN ASTOUNDING FLURRY GETS BURNT TO A CINDER.  THE ASHES BLOW AWAY.
THE AXE BOUNCES HARMLESSLY OFF THE DRAGON'S THICK SCALES.
SOMETHING YOU'RE CARRYING WON'T FIT THROUGH THE TUNNEL WITH YOU.  YOU'D BEST TAKE INVENTORY AND DROP SOMETHING.
THE BOTTLE OF WATER IS NOW EMPTY.
YOU HAVE TAKEN A DRINK FROM THE STREAM.  THE WATER TASTES STRONGLY OF MINERALS, BUT IS NOT UNPLEASANT.  IT IS EXTREMELY COLD.
RUBBING THE ELECTRIC LAMP IS NOT PARTICULARLY REWARDING.  ANYWAY
THERE IS NOTHING HERE TO EAT.
I'M GAME.  WOULD YOU CARE TO EXPLAIN HOW?
DON'T BE RIDICULOUS!
PECULIAR.  NOTHING UNEXPECTED HAPPENS.
I BELIEVE WHAT YOU WANT IS RIGHT HERE WITH YOU.
YOU ARE ALREADY CARRYING IT!
I CAN ONLY TELL YOU WHAT YOU SEE AS YOU MOVE ABOUT AND MANIPULATE THINGS.  I CANNOT TELL YOU WHERE REMOTE THINGS ARE.
BLASTING REQUIRES DYNAMITE.

THE TREES OF THE FOREST ARE LARGE HARDWOOD OAK AND MAPLE, WITH AN OCCASIONAL GROVE OF PINE OR SPRUCE.  THERE IS QUITE A BIT OF UNDER-GROWTH, LARGELY BIRCH AND ASH SAPLINGS PLUS NONDESCRIPT BUSHES OF VARIOUS SORTS.  THIS TIME OF YEAR VISIBILITY IS QUITE RESTRICTED BY ALL THE LEAVES, BUT TRAVEL IS QUITE EASY IF YOU DETOUR AROUND THE SPRUCE AND BERRY BUSHES.
DDIGGING WITHOUT A SHOVEL IS QUITE IMPRACTICAL.  EVEN WITH A SHOVEL PROGRESS IS UNLIKELY.
I'M AS CONFUSED AS YOU ARE.
MIST IS A WHITE VAPOR, USUALLY WATER, SEEN FROM TIME TO TIME IN CAVERNS.  IT CAN BE FOUND ANYWHERE BUT IS FREQUENTLY A SIGN OF A DEEP PIT LEADING DOWN TO WATER.
I AM UNSURE HOW YOU ARE FACING.  USE COMPASS POINTS OR NEARBY OBJECTS.
WATCH IT!
I DON'T KNOW THE WORD "STOP".  USE "QUIT" IF YOU WANT TO GIVE UP.
I DON'T KNOW HOW.
